_doc: Console card for showcase row 5b: the tail of a full `just gate-live --port 55545` run (the
command run on the rig: the recipe passes its args to ./gerda gate) - the summary
scripts/dev/gate_live.py prints (`  PASS  <name>` per arena, then per leg bench, then
`[gate] <passed>/<total> passed`). The rows are the gate's DEFAULT set (every arena with
expect.events or checks, then every leg bench) in its own order, and the last line is the all-PASS
count of those rows; scripts/tests/test_showcase.py holds both to the code, so a newly gated
arena breaks this card instead of going missing from it. The text is the summary a full
pass would print, not a measured result: from_log makes the render refuse unless --log names
a run whose summary is these lines verbatim (console_card.py check_log).
title: gerda — live gate
